##### Figure 4a: UMAP of PanCK+ AOIs
```{r, fig.width = 3.2, fig.height = 4}
PanCK_seurat <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "PanCK_seurat.rds"))

umap_data <- Embeddings(PanCK_seurat, "umap") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(UMAP1 = umap_1, UMAP2 = umap_2) %>%
  mutate(Category_Group = paste0(PanCK_seurat$Category, " - ", PanCK_seurat$Group),
         # SE and CLE have epithelium only: named by the category, as in Figure 4c-e (AE keeps its two groups)
         Category_Group = dplyr::recode(Category_Group, "Cancer-like endometriosis - Epithelial" = "Cancer-like endometriosis",
                                        "Simple endometriosis - Epithelial" = "Simple endometriosis"))
Category_Group_4a <- c(Category_Group, "Cancer-like endometriosis" = Category_Group[["Cancer-like endometriosis - Epithelial"]],
                       "Simple endometriosis" = Category_Group[["Simple endometriosis - Epithelial"]])

# Short axis arrows (20% of each range) in the bottom-left corner
x_range <- range(umap_data$UMAP1)
y_range <- range(umap_data$UMAP2)
x_start <- x_range[1] - 0.5
y_start <- y_range[1] - 0.5
x_length <- 0.2 * diff(x_range)
y_length <- 0.2 * diff(y_range)

Figure4a <- ggplot(umap_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, fill = Category_Group)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, alpha = 0.9, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Category_Group_4a) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  labs(fill = NULL) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_start + x_length, yend = y_start),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_start, yend = y_start + y_length),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = x_start + x_length / 2, y = y_start - 0.02 * diff(y_range), label = "UMAP1", vjust = 1, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = x_start, y = y_start + y_length / 2, label = "UMAP2", angle = 90, vjust = -0.6, hjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 15, l = 15))  # room for the UMAP arrows and labels
Figure4a

save_plot(Figure4a, "Figure4a.svg", width = 3.2, height = 4)
save_source_data(umap_data, "Figure4a", rownames_to = "AOI")
```

##### Differential expression: each category/compartment vs the mean of the others
```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))

keep <- spe_ruv$Segment == "PanCK" & spe_ruv$Group %in% c("Epithelial", "Atypical Epithelial", "Cancer")
spe_sub <- spe_ruv[, keep]
dge <- spe_to_dge(spe_ruv)[, keep]

category_group <- paste0(spe_sub$Category, "_", gsub("Atypical Epithelial", "Epithelial", spe_sub$Group))
colData(spe_sub)$Category_Group <- gsub("^(Atypical endometriosis|Cancer-like endometriosis|Simple endometriosis)_Epithelial$",
                                        "\\1", category_group)
table(colData(spe_sub)$Category_Group)
```

```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~0 + Category_Group + ruv_W1 + ruv_W2 + ruv_W3, data = colData(spe_sub)) %>%
  tidy_design("Category_Group")

# One-vs-rest contrasts: group - (sum of the other groups) / (n - 1)
cats <- setdiff(colnames(design), c("ruv_W1", "ruv_W2", "ruv_W3"))
contrast_list <- lapply(cats, function(g) {
  others <- setdiff(cats, g)
  paste0(g, " - (", paste(others, collapse = " + "), ")/", length(others))
})
names(contrast_list) <- cats
contr.matrix <- do.call(makeContrasts, c(contrast_list, list(levels = design)))

res <- fit_dge(dge, design, contr.matrix, block = factor(colData(spe_sub)$Patient))
efit <- res$efit
```

```{r}
all_tables <- lapply(setNames(colnames(contr.matrix), colnames(contr.matrix)), function(coef) top_table(efit, coef))

# Source data: genes up-regulated in each group (FDR < 0.05, log2FC > 1.5)
sig_tables <- lapply(all_tables, function(tt) subset(tt, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 1.5))
sapply(sig_tables, nrow)
# (gene names as a column: bind_rows() would make duplicated row names unique as "GENE...n")
combined_sig <- bind_rows(lapply(names(sig_tables), function(group) {
  if (nrow(sig_tables[[group]]) > 0) mutate(rownames_to_column(sig_tables[[group]], "Gene"), Category_Group = group)
}))
save_tables(combined_sig, "Figure4.xlsx", rownames_to = NULL)
```

##### Figure 4c: selected genes per group
```{r}
# Functional group of each gene: first program of epithelial_programs that contains it
program_of <- function(genes) {
  out <- rep("Other", length(genes))
  for (p in rev(names(epithelial_programs))) out[genes %in% epithelial_programs[[p]]] <- p
  out
}

# Contrast name -> "Category - Group" label used by the Category_Group palette (as in Figure 4a)
group_labels <- unique(data.frame(
  coef = gsub("[ -]", "_", colData(spe_sub)$Category_Group),
  label = paste0(spe_sub$Category, " - ", gsub("Atypical Epithelial", "Epithelial", spe_sub$Group))))
group_labels <- setNames(group_labels$label, group_labels$coef)
stopifnot(all(colnames(contr.matrix) %in% names(group_labels)), all(group_labels %in% names(Category_Group)))

# The endometriosis groups have epithelium only (AE pools epithelial and atypical epithelial AOIs):
# in Figure 4c-e they are labelled by the category alone, in the colour of their epithelium
endo_labels <- c("Atypical endometriosis - Epithelial" = "Atypical endometriosis",
                 "Cancer-like endometriosis - Epithelial" = "Cancer-like endometriosis",
                 "Simple endometriosis - Epithelial" = "Simple endometriosis")
short_group <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(endo_labels), endo_labels[x], x)
group_labels <- setNames(short_group(group_labels), names(group_labels))
Category_Group_4 <- c(Category_Group, setNames(Category_Group[names(endo_labels)], endo_labels))

all_markers_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(all_tables), function(coef) {
  df <- all_tables[[coef]]
  df$Category <- group_labels[[coef]]
  df$Gene <- rownames(df)
  df
})) %>%
  mutate(log10q = -log10(adj.P.Val),
         Category = factor(Category, levels = unique(Category)),
         Gene = factor(Gene, levels = unique(Gene))) %>%
  arrange(Category, desc(logFC))

df2 <- all_markers_df %>%
  mutate(Function = program_of(Gene),
         Gene = factor(Gene, levels = unique(Gene[order(Function, Gene)])),
         Function = factor(Function, levels = names(epithelial_programs))) %>%
  subset(Function != "Other")
```

```{r, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 4.2}
dotplot_top <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = Gene, y = Category, fill = logFC, size = log10q)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = ifelse(df2$adj.P.Val < 0.05, "black", "NA")) +
  scale_size(range = c(0.5, 3.5)) +  # smaller dots, so neighbouring genes do not overlap
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b", midpoint = 0, name = expression(log[2]*" FC")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, size = expression(-log[10](q~value))) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Function, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "horizontal")

cleveland_top <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = Gene, y = logFC, color = "black", fill = Category, size = log10q)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Gene), color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = ifelse(df2$adj.P.Val < 0.05, "black", "NA")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Category_Group_4) +
  scale_size(range = c(0.5, 3.5)) +  # same dot sizes as the dot plot
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid(. ~ Function, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = expression(log[2]*" FC"), color = "Contrast", size = expression(-log[10](q~value))) +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),  # slightly smaller gene names
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.box = "horizontal")

# cleveland plot shorter than the dot plot (centred on its rows and gene labels)
cleveland_short <- plot_grid(NULL, cleveland_top, NULL, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.2, 0.7, 0.1))
Figure4c <- plot_grid(dotplot_top, cleveland_short, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1.5, 1))  # dot plot needs the room
Figure4c

save_plot(Figure4c, "Figure4c.svg", width = 13, height = 4.2)
save_source_data(list(Selected_genes = dplyr::select(df2, Gene, Function, Category, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val,
                                                     `-log10(q value)` = log10q),
                      Up_FDR0.05_log2FC1.5 = dplyr::select(combined_sig, Category_Group, Gene, everything())),
                 "Figure4c")
```

##### Figure 4b: heatmap of the selected genes (8 row and column clusters)
```{r, fig.width = 8.2, fig.height = 5}
expr_scaled <- t(scale(t(res$vobj$E[rownames(res$vobj$E) %in% df2$Gene, ])))

annotation_col <- data.frame(Category = dge$samples$Category,
                             Group = dge$samples$Group)
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(expr_scaled)

Figure4b <- pheatmap(expr_scaled,
                     annotation_col = annotation_col,
                     annotation_colors = list(Category = Category, Group = Group),
                     annotation_names_row = FALSE,
                     annotation_legend = TRUE,
                     show_rownames = TRUE,
                     show_colnames = FALSE,
                     cluster_rows = TRUE,
                     cluster_cols = TRUE,
                     cutree_cols = 8,
                     cutree_rows = 8,
                     clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                     clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
                     clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
                     fontsize_row = 6.5,
                     fontsize = 7,
                     name = "Scaled expression",
                     border_color = "black",
                     color = color,
                     breaks = seq(-max(abs(expr_scaled), na.rm = TRUE), max(abs(expr_scaled), na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 101))
Figure4b

# heatmap and annotation legends in one column, so the colour bar does not run into "Group"
save_plot(grid::grid.grabExpr(ComplexHeatmap::draw(Figure4b, merge_legend = TRUE), width = 8.2, height = 5),
          "Figure4b.svg", width = 8.2, height = 5)

# Source data: scaled expression in the heatmap order, with the 8 row and column clusters
# (pheatmap here is ComplexHeatmap's: rows and columns are split into the cutree slices)
row_slices <- suppressMessages(row_order(Figure4b))
col_slices <- suppressMessages(column_order(Figure4b))
row_ord <- unlist(row_slices)
col_ord <- unlist(col_slices)
save_source_data(list(Scaled_expression = data.frame(Gene = rownames(expr_scaled)[row_ord],
                                                     Cluster = rep(seq_along(row_slices), lengths(row_slices)),
                                                     expr_scaled[row_ord, col_ord], check.names = FALSE),
                      AOIs = data.frame(AOI = colnames(expr_scaled)[col_ord], annotation_col[col_ord, ],
                                        Cluster = rep(seq_along(col_slices), lengths(col_slices)))),
                 "Figure4b")
```

##### Figure 4d: expression of selected genes on the UMAP and by group
```{r}
aux.seurat <- subset(x = PanCK_seurat, subset = Group %in% c("Epithelial", "Atypical Epithelial", "Cancer"))
aux.seurat$Category_Group <- paste0(aux.seurat$Category, " - ", aux.seurat$Group)
aux.seurat$Category_Group <- str_replace(aux.seurat$Category_Group, " - Atypical Epithelial$", " - Epithelial")
aux.seurat$Category_Group <- unname(short_group(aux.seurat$Category_Group))   # endometriosis by category, as in 4c
aux.seurat <- ScaleData(aux.seurat, features = rownames(aux.seurat), verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 4.1}
# UMAP coloured by a value (top) and boxplots of that value by group (bottom)
umap_panels <- function(long_df, value_name, facet, box_ncol, box_legend = FALSE) {
  vmin <- min(long_df$Expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  vmax <- max(long_df$Expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  umap <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 1.5, fill = "white", color = "black") +
    geom_point(aes(color = Expression), shape = 16, size = 3) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"),
                          values = scales::rescale(c(vmin, 0, vmax)),
                          limits = c(vmin, vmax),
                          name = "Expression") +
    facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet)), ncol = box_ncol, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = "", x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank())
  box <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = Category_Group, y = Expression, fill = Category_Group)) +
    geom_beeswarm(color = "black", shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.75, dodge.width = 1, priority = "density") +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = Category_Group_4) +
    facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet)), ncol = box_ncol, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Expression") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
  if (box_legend)  # category legend next to the boxplots (Figure 4e)
    box <- box + labs(fill = NULL) + guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
      theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"))
  list(umap = umap, box = box)
}

genes <- c("PGR", "ESR1",        # SE
           "MUC5B", "PAEP",      # CLE
           "LEFTY1", "PTHLH",    # CCC
           "DKK1", "DKK4")       # EC

plot_data_long <- FetchData(aux.seurat, vars = c("umap_1", "umap_2", genes, "Category", "Category_Group"), layer = "scale.data") %>%
  rownames_to_column("AOI") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genes), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Expression") %>%
  rename(UMAP1 = umap_1, UMAP2 = umap_2) %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = genes))

panels <- umap_panels(plot_data_long, "Expression", "Gene", box_ncol = length(genes))
Figure4d <- plot_grid(panels$umap, panels$box, ncol = 1, nrow = 2, align = "hv", axis = "tblr")
Figure4d

save_plot(Figure4d, "Figure4d.svg", width = 13, height = 4.1)
save_source_data(dplyr::rename(plot_data_long, `Scaled expression` = Expression), "Figure4d")
```

##### Figure 4e: module scores
```{r, fig.width = 10.25, fig.height = 4.1}
aux.seurat <- AddModuleScore(object = aux.seurat, features = unname(module_genes), ctrl = 50, name = "cell_state")
saveRDS(aux.seurat, file = file.path(path_rds, "Seurat_Panck_score.rds"))

scores <- paste0("cell_state", seq_along(module_genes))
plot_score_long <- FetchData(aux.seurat, vars = c("umap_1", "umap_2", scores, "Category", "Category_Group"), layer = "scale.data") %>%
  rownames_to_column("AOI") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(scores), names_to = "Score", values_to = "Expression") %>%
  rename(UMAP1 = umap_1, UMAP2 = umap_2) %>%
  mutate(Score = names(module_genes)[match(Score, scores)])

panels <- umap_panels(plot_score_long, "Expression", "Score", box_ncol = 5, box_legend = TRUE)
Figure4e <- plot_grid(panels$umap, panels$box, ncol = 1, nrow = 2, align = "hv", axis = "tblr")
Figure4e

save_plot(Figure4e, "Figure4e.svg", width = 10.25, height = 4.1)
save_plot(Figure4e, "Figure4e.pdf", width = 10.25, height = 4.1)
save_source_data(dplyr::rename(plot_score_long, `Module score` = Expression), "Figure4e")
```
